t: This is the 24th Division War Memorial in Battersea Park, a First World War memorial with a distinctly unusual, avant-garde design. It was unveiled in 1924 and became a Grade II* listed building in 2005. It was made by Eric Kennington, and it was his first public commission. Kennington was an English sculptor, artist and illustrator, and an official war artist in both of the world wars, so he knew the subject well.
